mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a tiny home depends heavily on its size, materials, design features, and whether it's built on a foundation or wheels. Generally, a professionally built tiny home can range from $60,000 to over $150,000. This estimate usually includes the shell, interior finishes, and basic systems. Factors like custom cabinetry, off-grid systems (solar, water harvesting), and high-end appliances will increase the overall investment. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific requirements and budget.
